title: Follow-ups: live words keep the start and end of what he says, the live-key check never passes on a network fault, and CLIVE's records, watch and secret removal say what is true
requested_outcome:
Nine follow-ups from the round-12 deploy review, filed as work for the next build under the owner's ship rule of 30 September, in live voice, the records CLIVE keeps about itself and the operator scripts. Fix each with a test that fails on the code at the base commit.
- S4/S4-N01 (web/live-voice.js openTap, loadWorklet, start): on a first hold, recording starts while openTap awaits the worklet module; what he says in that time never reaches the live transcriber, so the words on the bar miss the start of the question.
- S4/S4-N02 (web/live-voice.js WORKLET_SOURCE, quiet, release): the worklet posts only whole 1,024-frame buffers and release turns its message handler off at once, so the last part-buffer and messages already posted are lost before the final commit.
- SC2/SC2-02 (scripts/live_key_check.py open_once, check): a transport error (OSError, a timeout, a service failure) is called a refusal, so a network fault can pass the single-use and expiry checks.
- O1/O1-02 (app/observability/visible.py _whole and the FOCUS_LOST rule): a malformed count becomes 0, so a composer field reporting a non-numeric chars after a valid count is called FOCUS_LOST, and a malformed scroll depth reads as a return to the top.
- O2/O2-N-03 (app/observability/claims.py ON_SCREEN_RE, claims_on_screen): a present-tense claim made with 'in the app' ('Order #1938 is open in the app now.') is not recognised, so the on-screen claim check cannot catch it when nothing was drawn. This check reads the model's answer only, never the owner's words.
- SC1/SC1-02 (scripts/watch.py SAFE, Watch.lines): claim and drew are not on the allow-list, so the on_screen branch can never run and a screen claim is printed as a capability claim.
- R9-F-observability2-F-OBS2-01 (round 9, ruled still present at round 12; app/observability/visible.py, app/observability/timeline.py): a customer name a page sends in an identifier's shape passes as an identifier; the timeline's name rule takes out 'zoe-quill' for a told 'Zoe Quill' but not 'zoe_quill' or 'zoe.quill'.
- SC2/SC2-03 (scripts/provision_secrets.py store_one, remove_one): with an encrypted credential and a writable --plain copy of one key both present, --remove deletes the encrypted one and returns, leaving the writable copy in place.
- T1/T1-04 (tests/test_pad.py _limited_to_liveness): the limited-health helper lets the housekeeping check be missing, and its default value makes the shape check pass.
Live words stay display-only, never submitted and never in telemetry, and the batch recording stays the question CLIVE answers (tests/web/live-words-page.test.js). No secret value is read, printed or logged by the scripts or their tests: tests use temporary folders and the fake values of tests/fake_credentials.py, and removal never touches a key other than the one named. A refused caller's health stays the same shape.

What must not change, in every part of this build: every sentence the owner types or says still goes to the model exactly as said, and nothing here reads, answers or routes a sentence by a word list in front of it (deterministic code may check what the model did, never decide for it); every change to the shop or to email stays behind the owner's hold-to-confirm card, nothing here adds a write or skips staging, confirmation or verification, and reads stay reads; no private business data goes into git, and every name, address and order in a test is invented; no test assertion is weakened (an assertion changed here is made stricter, and the report names each one); the kernel, the gate, secret scanning and the acceptance machinery are untouched, and no protected path is edited (protected tests such as tests/test_compose.py, tests/test_engineering_bridge.py and tests/conftest.py are run, never changed); docs/phase4/TOOL_MATRIX.md is regenerated by the loop and never edited by hand. Plain British English in comments and docstrings that say what is true and why; no placeholder copy, invented defaults or filler.
acceptance_criteria: S4-N01: a node test, with the stand-ins tests/web/live-voice.test.js uses, holds addModule pending while audio reaches the tap: the audio from that time reaches the socket, in order, ahead of later audio; a device with no worklet keeps its ScriptProcessor path.

S4-N02: a release part-way through a 1,024-frame buffer, and a release with a posted message not yet delivered, both get those frames to the socket before the final commit, within a bounded wait; a worklet that never answers cannot hold the release past that bound.

SC2-02: live_key_check tells an explicit refusal of the key (the handshake refused for authorisation, or an error message from the service) apart from a connection, timeout or service failure; the latter is NOT ASKED with exit 2, never a pass. Tested with stand-ins for each case, with no network.

O1-02: a malformed chars or scroll value is unknown, not 0; FOCUS_LOST is emitted only when the measurements before and after are both valid; a malformed count after a valid one, and a malformed scroll depth, emit nothing, and the valid cases are unchanged.

O2-N-03: claims_on_screen is true for 'Order #1938 is open in the app now.' and 'It's up in the app.'; a question, an offer, the future, a condition or a negation with 'in the app' stays false, and 'in the App Store' is not a claim; tests/test_claims.py and tests/test_r13_screen_claim.py still pass.

SC1-02: Watch.lines prints an unsupported_claim event whose claim is on_screen as a screen claim (what was drawn, or that the answer was corrected); claim passes the allow-list only as one of its controlled values and drew only as a card type or identifier; a test passes such an event through Watch.lines.

R9-F-observability2-F-OBS2-01: a name the process has been told, sent by a page with its words joined by '_', '.', '-' or the other identifier separators, is withheld from every finding and from the report as the plain name is; an identifier that is not a told name is kept.

SC2-03: with both an encrypted credential and a writable copy of one key present (temporary folders, a fake value), --remove leaves neither and says both were removed; with only one present it removes that one; no other key is touched and no value is printed.

T1-04: _limited_to_liveness requires housekeeping in a refused caller's checks and asserts the shape of the value actually returned, including a failing housekeeping check; it still passes and is stricter, not weaker.

The new tests are in tests/test_followups_voice_records.py, with the node tests in tests/web/followups-live-voice.test.js run from it under node (skipped only where node is absent, as tests/test_web_js.py does, with '# fail 0' asserted); each fails on the base code, and the neighbouring tests and tests/test_r13_evidence_index.py still pass.
